claire.design: Quick question Current trace header shows Export as primary and a tiny copy icon for correlation id. Should we flip? raj.product: Flip to copy-first. Teams paste corr ids into tickets constantly. claire.design: Data? morgan.pm: Last 30d: copy 3.9x exports. sam.eng: Technically export can be async for large traces. If we demote export, show queued state and don't block UI. claire.design: Proposal: Primary = Copy chip (text), Secondary = Export dropdown (JSON/CSV). On mobile collapse export into overflow. aria.a11y: A11y notes: Make the chip keyboard-focusable, aria-label includes the id and action, announce copy success with aria-live="polite". Ensure full id exposed to screen readers (no ellipsis). claire.design: Example SR update:
then update text after copy. sam.eng: We'll implement sr-toast and an export job endpoint. Emit analytics: trace.copy_corr_id, trace.export_requested, trace.export_ready. claire.design: Also add shortcut hint (press ? for shortcuts) and a `c` shortcut to copy when trace panel focused. aria.a11y: Good if documented and non-conflicting. claire.design: I'll push an updated mock and a short spec with keyboard flows and SR messages. Thanks! :sparkles:
